title: gonolobus maritimus
intro: Gonolobus maritimus, commonly known as the sea vine, is a flowering plant in the Apocynaceae family. It is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America and is traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Gonolobus maritimus include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its analgesic and antispasmodic effects, which may help to relieve pain and muscle spasms, while its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids and glycosides, may contribute to its medicinal properties.
